decisions.reason: The firm recently invested in approval and launch of this vertigo combination, gave it a dedicated page as a visible commitment, and one year is too short to judge it, so any weak uptake can still be put down to the ramp-up period.

Registration costs for the generic are already sunk and the product is presented on its own page, so management will keep it and blame any early price pressure on normal generic market entry dynamics.

The combination antihypertensive fits the firm's cardiovascular prescription business, has been visibly launched with its own page, and is a long-term chronic therapy product whose early results are not yet conclusive.

The supplement involved lower investment and only a passing mention on the website, so the commitment is weaker, but after just one year management will still give it time rather than admit a misstep.
